style: AAA modern military PvP shooter marketing art, cinematic and gritty, high contrast, desaturated olive drab, gunmetal and charcoal with hot orange fire light and ember glow, sharp detailed rendering, dramatic rim lighting

items.prompt: A bold video game title logo wordmark reading WAR BASH on a single line. Heavy, wide, angular military capital letters with stencil cuts, made of brushed and scratched gunmetal steel with chipped olive paint, a thick dark outline, a subtle bevel and hot orange ember glow along the lower edges. A thin angular steel bar runs under the letters. Centered, filling most of the width, crisp clean silhouette that reads at small sizes.

A square mobile game app icon. A battle-worn steel military crest: an angular shield with the bold stencil monogram WB in the middle, two crossed modern assault rifles behind it, set on a dark charcoal and olive background with a hot orange glow rising from below. Strong simple shapes, centered, the crest fills about 80 percent of the canvas so it still reads at 48 pixels.

Cinematic wide key art for a modern war shooter. A lone modern soldier in full combat gear (helmet with goggles, plate carrier, gloves, rifle held low and ready) stands on broken concrete rubble, seen from slightly below, placed at the right side of the frame with the soldier's center at about 72 percent of the width from the left edge. The soldier is backlit by a huge burning orange sunset haze, distant explosions and a ruined city skyline. The left 45 percent of the frame is a dark, smoky, nearly empty sky, calm enough to put menu buttons over it. Drifting smoke and glowing embers. Keep every important element inside the middle 62 percent of the height: the top and bottom will be cropped to a 21:9 banner.
